name: Trade-Based Money Laundering
description: Disguising proceeds of crime and moving value through trade transactions by manipulating invoicing, quantity, quality or description of goods and services. Techniques include over- and under-invoicing, multiple invoicing, phantom shipments and use of unrelated third parties.

sources.text: FATF and Egmont Group, Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments (2020)
ICC, BAFT and Wolfsberg Group, Trade Finance Principles (2019 update)

exposure.rationale: Invoice manipulation and LC/bill of lading discrepancies in trade finance.

indicators.name: Invoice price significantly differs from market value
indicators.canon: Transaction price materially different from market value
indicators.desc: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
indicators.ctx: Unit prices are well above or below the normal market range for the goods without a commercial rationale.
indicators.fp: Discounts, grade differences, and volatile commodities can explain variance.

indicators.name: Goods description vague or inconsistent across documents
indicators.canon: Trade documents inconsistent with each other
indicators.desc: Bill of lading, invoice, customs, letter of credit or payment details disagree on goods, quantity, price, origin, parties or route.
indicators.ctx: Bill of lading, invoice and letter of credit describe quantity, goods or parties differently.
indicators.fp: Clerical errors or HS-code variations occur.

indicators.name: Multiple invoicing for the same shipment
indicators.canon: Same invoice or shipment financed or invoiced multiple times
indicators.desc: The same invoice, bill of lading or goods are presented to multiple financiers or invoiced more than once.
indicators.ctx: The same goods are invoiced or financed more than once, or payment references repeat.
indicators.fp: Partial shipments and amendments may seem like duplicates.

indicators.name: Shipping route illogical or via high-risk transshipment
indicators.canon: Routing through trade-diversion or transshipment hubs
indicators.desc: Goods or payments route through third-country hubs or ports with no commercial rationale, or hubs known for rerouting.
indicators.ctx: Goods travel through jurisdictions with no commercial reason or known risk of trade abuse.
indicators.fp: Route changes follow port congestion or carrier network design.

indicators.name: Payment from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Payments for goods come from parties not named in the contract or documentation.
indicators.fp: Group treasury centres and factoring can legitimately pay.

indicators.name: Shipment volume exceeds the counterparty's capability
indicators.canon: Shipment volume exceeds the counterparty's capability
indicators.desc: Quantities or values are out of proportion to the size, history or industry of trading parties.
indicators.ctx: Quantities or values are out of proportion to the size, history or industry of trading parties.

indicators.name: Dual-use or high-risk goods without supporting licences
indicators.canon: Dual-use or high-risk goods without supporting licences
indicators.desc: Trade in goods commonly abused for value transfer (used cars, electronics, gold, scrap) lacks usual licences or logistics.
indicators.ctx: Trade in goods commonly abused for value transfer (used cars, electronics, gold, scrap) lacks usual licences or logistics.

indicators.name: Phantom shipment indicators
indicators.desc: No verifiable movement of goods: missing tracking, inspection or insurance evidence.
indicators.ctx: No verifiable movement of goods: missing tracking, inspection or insurance evidence.

indicators.name: Frequent amendments or letter of credit changes
indicators.canon: Frequent amendments or letter of credit changes
indicators.desc: Repeated changes to beneficiaries, payment terms or amounts shortly before payment.
indicators.ctx: Repeated changes to beneficiaries, payment terms or amounts shortly before payment.
